title: Evaluating and Simplifying Polynomial Compositions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Given f(x) = x + 5 and g(x) = x^2 - 3, find the following values and expressions: (a) f(g(0)), (b) g(f(0)), (c) f(g(x)), (d) g(f(x)), (e) f(f(-5)), (f) g(g(2)), (g) f(f(x)), and (h) g(g(x)).

steps.title: Evaluate Numerical Compositions in Parts (a), (b), (e), and (f)
steps.explanation: To evaluate a nested composition at a number, first evaluate the inner function at the given input, and then substitute that numerical result into the outer function.
steps.why: Function composition (u o v)(a) is defined by sequential evaluation u(v(a)) from inside out.

steps.title: Find Symbolic Cross-Compositions in Parts (c) and (d)
steps.explanation: For f(g(x)), replace x in f(x) = x + 5 with g(x) = x^2 - 3. For g(f(x)), replace x in g(x) = x^2 - 3 with f(x) = x + 5 and expand the binomial square.
steps.why: Symbolic composition replaces every occurrence of the independent variable in the outer formula with the entire inner formula.

steps.title: Find Symbolic Self-Compositions in Parts (g) and (h)
steps.explanation: Substitute f(x) into f for part (g), and substitute g(x) into g for part (h), expanding (x^2 - 3)^2 = x^4 - 6x^2 + 9 before subtracting 3.
steps.why: Self-composition applies the same functional rule twice in succession.
